text: python3 -m token_wyrm --help works and documents --seed, --load, --no-color, and --self-check.
python3 -m token_wyrm --seed 7 --self-check runs a deterministic non-interactive simulation and exits 0.
Same seed produces the same dungeon, enemy, and item layout; different seeds can produce different layouts.
Map generation creates a rectangular grid with rooms and corridors, and every start, stairs, item, and enemy is reachable and not inside a wall.
Movement supports WASD/arrows and collision prevents walking through walls; enemies act only after player turns.
Combat supports bump attacks, HP, damage, defense, enemy death, player death, and message-log output.
At least four enemy types, a final boss, and a clear win condition after reaching the final depth and defeating the boss.
Inventory supports at least health potions, weapons, armor, gold, and a rare token, with pickup, drop, use, equip, and unequip.
Save/load uses versioned JSON and round-trips map, depth, player, inventory, equipment, enemies, floor items, log, and RNG state; corrupt saves fail cleanly.
The terminal UI shows the map, HP, depth, gold, message log, controls, and clear win/lose screens, with optional ANSI color and --no-color support.
At least 25 meaningful pytest tests exist and python3 -m pytest -q passes without an interactive terminal.
Runtime uses only the Python standard library, with no network access, no binary assets, and no third-party runtime dependencies.
README explains setup, controls, flags, save format, and test commands; code is split into focused modules with type hints.
